subject: Security assessment vendor onboarding — SOW & insurance clarifications
messages:
From: Oliver Stone <oliver@veridian-security.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@veridian-security.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: annual security assessment — SOW attached

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. Attached is Veridian Security's proposed SOW (Veridian_SOW_v3.pdf) and a line-item quote for the annual security assessment you requested: external penetration test (web app + API), optional red-team add-on, and a control review.

High level:
- Price (base): $38,500 — external pen test, two testers, 5 business days of testing
- Red team (optional): add $22,000 (separate addendum)
- Draft report: 5 business days after testing window; final report (with exec summary and remediation plan) within 10 business days after draft
- Deliverables: full technical report, prioritized findings, two-hour remediation walkthrough

What we need from you to proceed: signed SOW, PO or billing details, and a Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference as additional insured. We can accept DocuSign for the SOW.

I attached the SOW and the initial invoice stub for planning purposes. Let me know if you want us to split the invoice into milestones (test / report).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to go over specifics.

Regards,
Oliver Stone
Business Development
Veridian Security, Inc.
[Attachment: Veridian_SOW_v3.pdf]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Stone <oliver@veridian-security.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: annual security assessment — SOW attached

Thanks Oliver — quick clarifications before we loop procurement:

1) Insurance: Redwood requires a COI naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured with $5M aggregate / $2M per occurrence. Can Veridian provide that or confirm carrier details?
2) Liability cap in the SOW is currently $2M — is that flexible? If we need to get to $5M we'll need to budget for that.
3) Social engineering / phishing: we prefer to keep any social-engineering testing out of scope unless we sign a separate social-engineering addendum. Please confirm red-team scope excludes that by default.
4) Data handling: please confirm logs/notes from testing are retained for no more than 90 days unless agreed otherwise, and that ephemeral test artifacts will be wiped on report delivery.
5) Timeline: can you propose firm testing windows in August / September? We need to align product and infra teams.

Procurement contact is karthik_iyer@redwood.com — looping Marissa for technical scope alignment.

If you can address the COI + liability question quickly we can get a PO in place. Attached is a copy of the SOW with a couple of inline comments.

— Stephanie
Sr. Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Veridian_SOW_v3_comments.pdf]

From: Oliver Stone <oliver@veridian-security.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@veridian-security.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: annual security assessment — SOW attached

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the detailed notes. Responses below and I updated the SOW to v3.1 (attached).

- COI: we can provide a Certificate of Insurance naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured. Carrier: NorthEdge Insurance; we will send the COI PDF once procurement confirms the addressee.
- Liability cap: our standard is $2M; we can increase to $5M for this engagement for an additional $4,000 premium. If that is required, please confirm and we'll include it in final invoice.
- Social engineering: confirmed — social engineering / phishing will be explicitly excluded unless you sign the social-engineering addendum. We'll add that clause to the SOW.
- Data retention: we are happy to commit to deletion of ephemeral test artifacts 90 days after final report delivery and to limit persistent logs to what's necessary for triage. We'll include language in the SOW.
- Proposed testing window: Aug 17–21 (testing), draft report Aug 28, final report Sep 4. If that window works, we'll reserve testers and start scheduling.

We can also split billing into two invoices: 60% (testing) due on test start, 40% on final report. Net30 terms acceptable.

Attached: Veridian_SOW_v3.1.pdf (with the added clauses)

Regards,
Oliver
[Attachment: Veridian_SOW_v3.1.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Oliver Stone <oliver@veridian-security.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement info & PO process

Oliver — thanks. A few procurement items so we can issue a PO: 
- Please send W-9 or equivalent tax form and vendor address for our AP team.
- COI should include "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured and list the Redwood corporate address: 500 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- Invoice should be billed to Redwood Inference, Inc.; remit to the address on the invoice (we prefer electronic invoice to ap-invoices@redwood.com).
- Payment terms: Net30 is acceptable.
- Data handling: please confirm the process for secure transfer of test artifacts (SFTP or encrypted upload) and the retention/deletion timeline in the SOW (we require a statement that all ephemeral logs will be destroyed after 90 days).

Also please include the vendor point-of-contact for insurance claims and the carrier name on the COI. Once we have W-9 + COI + final SOW we'll raise a PO (target within 5 business days).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Oliver Stone <oliver@veridian-security.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement info & PO process — scope confirmation

Quick internal notes / confirmations before PO: 
- Confirming we do NOT want phishing/social-engineering included in the baseline red-team exercise. Oliver confirmed and will remove by default.
- For testing accounts: Veridian will use customer-provided test accounts only (we'll provide a list of non-production hosts, test API keys, and FQDNs).
- Please confirm the red-team will not run destructive tests without explicit written approval; we require a kill-switch/stop test process.

Marissa — can you confirm the final asset list (apps and FQDNs) by EOD next Tuesday (Aug 4) so we can lock the Aug 17 testing window?

Thanks — if procurement receives W-9 + COI + final SOW we can proceed with PO issuance.

— Stephanie

From: Oliver Stone <oliver@veridian-security.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement info & PO process — COI and invoice attached

Stephanie / Karthik — attaching the requested items: Certificate of Insurance (Veridian_COI.pdf) naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured (carrier: NorthEdge Insurance), plus Invoice_1234.pdf for the base engagement. Per our call: liability cap increase to $5M will be a +$4k premium — invoice reflects base price; we will issue an updated invoice if you confirm the increased cap.

We have removed social-engineering from scope and added the data-retention clause in SOW v3.1. We will only use customer-provided test accounts and will not perform destructive actions without explicit sign-off (kill-switch as requested).

Please confirm PO number and whether you want the $5M liability upgrade; once we have PO we will send DocuSign for signature.

Best,
Oliver
Veridian Security
[Attachment: Veridian_COI.pdf] [Attachment: Invoice_1234.pdf]
